attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates no member, so it is one folder for the company. They are not the Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, whom the corpus keeps as forty named folders on 9 March, nor `forty-thousand-martyrs`, `forty-five-martyrs-of-nicopolis`, `forty-two-martyrs-of-amorion`, `forty-virgins-of-adrianople` or `forty-martyrs-with-john-the-egyptian`: these forty are Roman and died by fire. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
